entries.name: M-VAVE Original-Firmware
entries.author: M-VAVE
entries.description: Die Werks-Firmware des FM-1: 6-Operator-FM wie der DX7, 128 Presets, Arpeggiator und Step-Sequencer. Mit ihr kommst du von jeder Custom-Firmware zurück.

entries.name: FM1 Open
entries.author: m-vave
entries.description: M-VAVE's own open firmware repository. V14 adds 8 tracks, 8 sample slots and 16 FX demos; releases carry the development kit, a binary device-engine SDK and a browser workbench. Most new firmwares build on it or on fm1-base.
entries.license: GPL-3.0 with the FM1 SDK linking exception

entries.name: Felucca
entries.author: Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments)
entries.description: Multi-engine synth firmware by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments). Thirteen engines (6-op FM, VA, phase distortion, chiptune, sampler, granular, physical modelling, organ, drums), four tracks, 64-step sequencer, song mode, mod matrix, USB audio, web installer, web editor and browser emulator. The platform most other firmwares build on.

entries.name: SLOOP
entries.author: 3dSam
entries.description: Live four-track groovebox by 3dSam: three synths plus a drum machine, 37 drum kits, punch-in FX, layer system, song mode, web editor. Based on Felucca.

entries.name: X0X
entries.author: Charles Vestal
entries.description: ReBirth-style groovebox by Charles Vestal: TR-909, TR-808, two TB-303s with TB-3PO acid generators and a breakbeat slicer, each with its own sequencer. Has a browser emulator and manual. Felucca fork.

entries.name: FoMni
entries.author: Charles Vestal
entries.description: Omnichord-style chord harp by Charles Vestal: strum the white keys, pick chords on the black ones, with rhythm patterns and auto bass. Installer and browser emulator.

entries.name: BB1 (Big Beat)
entries.author: TexasRADIO
entries.description: Rhythm firmware by TexasRADIO: two drum machines (KIT A and KIT B, each with its own pattern) and Dillo, an Open303-derived acid bass, through three-head tape echo and spring reverb. A synthesised 808 plus sampled LinnDrum, LM-1, DrumTraks, DMX, Drumulator, Simmons and Rhythm King; 67 songs and 21 eras at their own tempos, 205 ACID bass phrases, MIDI in, saved scenes, a one-click installer, browser emulator and guide. Felucca-based.

entries.name: sloopDX
entries.author: zvenson
entries.description: SLOOP fork that replaces its engines with a single six-operator DX7 engine ported from Dexed, every voice parameter editable on the device, room for 256 voices and 128-step patterns. Installer and editor.

entries.name: GHOULBOX
entries.author: Jason Persinger
entries.description: Dungeon synth firmware by Jason Persinger: cathedral reverb, worn-tape effect, hurdy-gurdy engine with drones, dark ambient presets and an old-RPG screen. Felucca fork.

entries.name: ChoralRoot FM-1
entries.author: Quixotic7
entries.description: Orchid-style chord instrument: one hand plays roots, the other shapes chords, with voicings, key modes, bass and a looper. Installer and browser emulator. Built on Felucca.

entries.name: Hortator
entries.author: DEADACTIVE
entries.description: Eight-track drum machine by DEADACTIVE with 808, 909 and Plaits drum models, samples, Mutable Instruments Grids, a pumping compressor and resonators. Play it in the browser. Built on Felucca.

entries.name: FiMba-1
entries.author: jadamsowers
entries.description: Physically modelled kalimba with mbira patterns, granular cloud and tape. Installer and emulator. Built on Felucca, X0X and FoMni.

entries.name: zp12
entries.author: zvenson
entries.description: 12-bit sampling drum machine in the spirit of the SP-12: 32 pads at 26 kHz, loops on the black keys, swing, songs and a browser sample editor. SLOOP fork on sloopDX's platform.

entries.name: ORBIT
entries.author: dspaudio
entries.description: SLOOP-based groovebox with OP-1-inspired screens, sample tools and an event tape for moving what the four tracks play. Browser emulator.

entries.name: AMB-1
entries.author: charlesvestal
entries.description: Generative ambient machine inspired by Music for Airports that plays itself from power-on: tape loops of unequal length, gliding bass, Euclidean percussion. Installer, emulator and manual.

entries.name: CTL-1
entries.author: charlesvestal
entries.description: Turns the FM-1 into a MIDI controller, with General MIDI sounds of its own. Web installer.

entries.name: FuMi-1
entries.author: cartesive
entries.description: Shigin accompaniment instrument inspired by Suikohsha's ST-50, with koto, sho, shakuhachi and taiko voices and the ST-50's just tuning. Installer and emulator. FoMni fork.

entries.name: fm1-chord
entries.author: math0ne
entries.description: Chord machine with chord sequencer, drum loops, looper and ear trainer. Installs from a script rather than a web page. Built on Felucca.

entries.name: WaveLoop FM-1
entries.author: ELI7VH
entries.description: Felucca played from an Arturia MiniLab 3: track faders, follow-the-track knobs, DJ filter and momentary effect pads. Web installer.

entries.name: Rainbow mode
entries.author: joshbartlettband-web
entries.description: Music toy for small children: coloured notes, 40 animal friends with sounds and beats, a volume limit, and the full Felucca synth behind a key combo. Installer and emulator.

entries.name: PurpleMonkey FM-1
entries.author: Quixotic7
entries.description: First instrument for a small child, by ChoralRoot's author: five-note scale, drums, a backing beat and no menus. Browser emulator.

entries.name: FM1 Quest
entries.author: hericdk
entries.description: SLOOP reskinned as a pixel-art RPG: tracks are heroes, steps are attacks, recording a loop is a boss fight. All SLOOP functions stay in place. Browser emulator.

entries.name: Jangada
entries.author: zednaked
entries.description: Felucca fork adding superwave analog, a modulation matrix, latched drones, ratchets and synthesized drum kits.

entries.name: Melodee
entries.author: keremimo
entries.description: Felucca derivative that went its own way: ten engines, eight patterns per track, STUDIO workspaces, four-channel USB audio input, TR-808 kit. Web installer.

entries.name: SLOOP ALG
entries.author: shaw-core
entries.description: Experimental SLOOP fork (Chinese README) adding DX7, VA, Karplus-Strong, pluck and additive engines, with its own web installer and editor.

entries.name: FM-1 B-Boy Edition
entries.author: friendsmakenoise-prog
entries.description: Early-stage sampler/groovebox firmware that treats the FM-1 as a late-90s chop sampler with three sample tracks and an FM lane.

entries.name: Lunar Modulator
entries.author: ip2k
entries.description: Research-stage open firmware built on Mutable Instruments engines (Plaits, Braids, Rings) and a Movy-style sequencer. Nothing flashed yet, but the virtual FM-1 in the browser is playable and the docs are a good map of the whole reverse-engineering effort.

entries.name: fm1-polyseq
entries.author: NOVALENTI
entries.description: Polyphonic 16-step sequencer and hardware abstraction layer in strict C99, written from scratch for the pi32v2 CPU.

entries.name: Optimist
entries.author: w0ts
entries.description: Modular firmware platform derived from SLOOP: a firmware builder lets you pick which engines, kits and effects fit in flash. Work in progress, tested on very little hardware.

entries.name: NoteSorcery
entries.author: catacombius
entries.description: OP-1-style eight-track groovebox built on SLOOP, with Ableton export, an Android companion and live sampling over USB. In development, not yet tested on a device.

entries.name: FM1 Move
entries.author: Nicodesy06
entries.description: Eight-track groovebox firmware with a performance-focused interface, a browser simulator and a manual. Early.

entries.name: TRIBE
entries.author: apiel
entries.description: Ten-track groovebox by apiel where any engine plays on any track: kicks, 909 and 808 voices and a 303, sixteen clips per track, scatter effects and two master effects. Web installer, browser emulator and manual. Beta.

entries.name: Felucca Salt
entries.author: Chance Roth
entries.description: Felucca fork by Chance Roth that ships with a browser Studio: switch between playing in the browser and editing a connected FM-1, with twelve themes and a docked keyboard. Web installer and Studio. Beta.

entries.name: MONK-1
entries.author: Charles Vestal
entries.description: Twelve singers for the FM-1 by Charles Vestal: Jonathan Taylor's MonkSynth formant vocal synthesizer with velocity and aftertouch from the FM-1's own keys. Installer, browser emulator and manual.

entries.name: Polly
entries.author: Charles Vestal
entries.description: QY70-style pocket arranger by Charles Vestal: a style plays a band of eight instruments steered by the chords you play, with General MIDI sounds from Sonivox EAS and use as a General MIDI sound module. Built on Felucca's platform layer, with a site for installing, learning and trying it in the browser.

entries.name: Velo
entries.author: Charles Vestal
entries.description: Experiment firmware by Charles Vestal that reads velocity (and aftertouch in drive mode) from the FM-1's rubber-dome keys through the chip's ADC, with no hardware changes. Work in progress, parked for now. Built on Felucca's platform.

entries.name: fm1-rocket-os
entries.author: cmlarsen
entries.description: Clip-launching performance firmware by cmlarsen, forked from X0X. Work in progress.

entries.name: MC-1
entries.author: dspaudio
entries.description: Original four-part groovebox: three melodic parts and a sixteen-lane drum part, 128 melodic presets, eight drum kits, song arrangement and recorded knob movement, all from one C core shared by device, host and browser. Installer and browser emulator.

entries.name: Felucca 8 Patterns
entries.author: echoe
entries.description: Felucca branch written with a free LLM: eight swappable sequences per track, sequence chaining, generative arpeggiator options, and user samples removed. Web installer.

entries.name: Bubba Machine
entries.author: Erbubar23
entries.description: Six-track groovebox written from scratch in C99: drums, pad sampler, bass, FM, wavetable and polyphonic machines. Site with browser emulator. Spanish README, English page available. Beta, tested on one FM-1.

entries.name: Skiff
entries.author: illuminus5
entries.description: Six-track groovebox with fourteen synth and drum engines, 143 factory sounds, a 64-step sequencer with chords, ratchets, trig conditions and parameter locks, patterns, songs and a browser editor. Site. Built on Felucca.

entries.name: JIANT FM
entries.author: juanjiant-bit
entries.description: Alternative firmware for playing live and building songs without a computer, forked from Felucca 1.1.5.1 with its song system taken from SLOOP. Browser emulator, web installer and web editor. In development.

entries.name: Tonitor
entries.author: nzimas
entries.description: Acousmatic firmware for electroacoustic experimentation and live ambient music, built around six tracks of sound objects with no tempo, step sequencer or drum kit. Web installer and manual.

entries.name: MAKU
entries.author: okumurari2
entries.description: Always-on ambience machine: it starts a new random in-key world on every boot and draws later ones from the pieces you like. Browser emulator. Felucca fork. Japanese and English README.

entries.name: DUELL
entries.author: OSCILL/R
entries.description: Bitimbral synthesizer by OSCILL/R: two complete parts, three ways to play them together and a morph between two versions of every sound. Browser emulator. Public beta, flashed on one FM-1 so far.

entries.name: FM-106
entries.author: PatttF
entries.description: Port of the KR-106 Juno-106 emulation to the FM-1: six voices, 128 factory presets, a BBD-style stereo chorus and dual-core DSP adapted from Melodee.

entries.name: HYP-1
entries.author: RustyPawz
entries.description: Generative hypnotic techno and acid machine from RedtailWorks that plays from power-on: pad, drone, generative 303 line and grain over drums you sequence. Installer, browser emulator and manual. AMB-1 fork.

entries.name: LOF-1
entries.author: RustyPawz
entries.description: Lofi groovebox from RedtailWorks: you play the lead and a tired jazz band follows the chords your notes imply, with comp, bass, drums, an answering voice and vinyl, tape and radio dust. Installer, browser emulator and manual. Experimental: not yet tested on a real FM-1. AMB-1 fork.

entries.name: ECO-1
entries.author: RustyPawz
entries.description: Generative plant from RedtailWorks: three leaves fire notes as light and water charge them over a stem drone, while a day and night cycle, rain and wind play the plant. Eight plants each in their own scene, MIDI clock in and per-voice MIDI out. Installer, browser emulator and manual. Experimental: not yet tested on a real FM-1. AMB-1 fork.

entries.name: GRAV-1
entries.author: RustyPawz
entries.description: Dark, spacey generative ambient from RedtailWorks: a star roars in coloured noise while up to six planets play phrases round their orbits, with their years set by a drum sequencer and comets and asteroids drifting through. MIDI clock in and per-voice MIDI out. Installer, browser emulator and manual. Experimental: not yet tested on a real FM-1. AMB-1 fork.

entries.name: BEETLE
entries.author: Joppe Sikken (SikkenWorks)
entries.description: Six-lane tracker and digital drum machine by Joppe Sikken (SikkenWorks). Web installer and web simulator. Release candidate.

entries.name: ETCH
entries.author: Joppe Sikken (SikkenWorks)
entries.description: Synth firmware by Joppe Sikken (SikkenWorks) with arpeggiator riffs, a poly mode, a modulation matrix and a USB MIDI keyboard boot mode. Site.

entries.name: CS-1
entries.author: twochannels
entries.description: CS-80-style synthesizer firmware for a dawless rig: eight two-channel voices, ring modulator, delay, phaser and plate reverb, played over TRS or USB MIDI from a sequencer such as the Novation Circuit Tracks. Built on Dinghy and FM-106. Has an in-browser demo and installer.

entries.name: Araminta
entries.author: Wulgaren
entries.description: Opinionated Felucca 1.5.1 fork that adds JIANT's DRUM-X and punch-ins, SLOOP's free take, mixer solo and an effects list you can chain or send. Web installer and browser emulator.

entries.name: UnholyUnion
entries.author: actuallysparky
entries.description: Generative ambient and drone firmware with Immaculate Permutation, which rolls an arrangement of pad, sequence and chord arpeggio in a shared key under a voice you play. Installer and guides. Built on Felucca and Jangada.

entries.name: TripDeck
entries.author: anonymousacademe
entries.description: Psychedelic synth where every screen is an animated picture and the four knobs change sound and picture together. Sitar and tamboura, pads, organ with Leslie, FM bells, shimmer reverb, vowel filter and spiral echo. Version 0.2, tested on the device.

entries.name: TheReFmB1rth
entries.author: AlexanderSeel
entries.description: Early experimental acid groovebox with two 303-style synths and 808 and 909 drum machines, pattern and song chaining and a four-track mixer. Based on Felucca 1.0.5. No license stated.

entries.name: IND-1
entries.author: devrvega
entries.description: Self-playing industrial machine after KMFDM, Nine Inch Nails and Ministry: it arranges its own songs from six layers and you can lock one and write it step by step. The screen shows a quest through a dark keep.

entries.name: LCD-4
entries.author: devrvega
entries.description: Four-track pocket groovebox (a drum machine and three synths) with chords, sixteen punch-in effects and a handheld-style LCD game for each sound. Browser emulator and web installer.

entries.name: SIDOU
entries.author: dsablic
entries.description: C64 SID instrument with a step sequencer, tracker, live-play mode, `.sid` playback and GoatTracker and SID-Wizard importers. Early: the first firmware has run only in an emulator and on the host, not yet on an FM-1. Browser demo.

entries.name: Glitchbox
entries.author: erikdevos
entries.description: Broken, dirty performance firmware with a glitch engine, crushed drums and live stutter and crush effects, aimed at Nine Inch Nails-style sounds. Experimental: not yet tested on a real FM-1. Try it in the browser. Felucca fork.

entries.name: Niagara Drift
entries.author: evanyerburgh
entries.description: Drone synth with two drifting virtual-analog drones, each with a partner oscillator, sub and resonant filter, through delay and reverb. 0.1 beta, try it in the browser.

entries.name: DUODRONE
entries.author: Philippe Jaccoud
entries.description: Two-voice analogue-style drone synth by Philippe Jaccoud, after the Stylophone CPM DS-2: morphing oscillators with -1/-2 octave subs, resonant LP/HP filters, hard sync and pitch link, a two-output LFO, a dark delay and an 8-algorithm reverb. Emulator and installer. Built on foma.

entries.name: CoralFlower
entries.author: FicusFicusov
entries.description: Chord instrument inspired by the Telepathic Instruments Orchid: every note becomes a chord with a bass underneath, while a pixel flower grows on screen. Play it in the browser or install it. Based on ChoralRoot FM-1 and Felucca.

entries.name: GammaWave (GW-1)
entries.author: fvalente
entries.description: Dual-core firmware and web studio with wavetable synthesis, an FFT spectrogram filter, a four-track tape deck and a 49-genre song generator. Companion to the commercial GammaWave VST. Web studio and USB installer.

entries.name: Patricktronics
entries.author: gaumondp
entries.description: Generative sound-bed firmware for Frippertronics-style ambient loops: a locked palette of up to five notes and one FM patch whose arrangement keeps mutating. Felucca fork.

entries.name: winampFM
entries.author: hericdk
entries.description: Winamp 2.x-style firmware where sounds are a playlist, four tracks record as loops and visualizers fill the screen. Installer and 3D simulator. Based on SLOOP 2.6.

entries.name: OberVave
entries.author: zvenson
entries.description: Single eight-voice analog-style polysynth after the classic American poly synths of 1979-84, with hard sync, cross-modulation, SEM-style filter morph, arpeggiator, two-track sequencer, 32 programs and chorus, delay and plate reverb. Installs from the FM-1 Firmware Hub.

entries.name: Tessera
entries.author: Rastapopolix
entries.description: Generative firmware, formerly Melodee (Tess): 13 generators, song forms and modulation on four tracks. Web installer.

entries.name: MYCELIUM
entries.author: megagott
entries.description: Forest, Psytrance, Goa and Hitech groovebox firmware with original drum assets and four factory songs. Built on Felucca and SLOOP, test release 1.0 with source archive included.

entries.name: REGGAE-OS
entries.author: KemstheSage
entries.description: Early reggae instrument firmware with 13 playable presets (organ, bass, melodica, electric piano, brass stabs, dub siren, drum kit) and four-knob editing. Browser emulator. Built on Felucca 1.6.1. Hardware untested.

entries.name: FOMAJAM
entries.author: konsumer
entries.description: Nine-track groovebox firmware with modelled and ROM-recorded drum machines (808, 909, SDS-V, CR-78 and more), Felucca engines plus STRING and SUPERSAW, 16-step patterns with accents, slides and ratchets, and MIDI out. Installer and emulator. Made with foma.

entries.name: Ketch
entries.author: risseraka
entries.description: Tracker firmware in the LSDJ and M8 line: song, chain and phrase screens, instruments, effects and a mixer, with four channels on Felucca's engines. 0.1 beta. Installer and emulator.

entries.name: MIN-1
entries.author: Reytian
entries.description: Self-playing minimalist ensemble inspired by AMB-1 and Philip Glass, by Reytian: repeating figures and slow chord cycles that you can take over, with EASY keys where every key is a chord. Installer and browser emulator.

entries.name: Evander's Music Box
entries.author: MikeTsak
entries.description: LARP firmware with a four-track medieval Bardic Crafting workshop and an Encounter mode where the white keys are sixteen soundtracks. Built on Felucca's hardware layer, with a browser emulator. Not yet flashed to a real FM-1.

entries.name: fm1-t1
entries.author: tensor-programming
entries.description: Work in progress firmware aiming at Torso T1 functionality. Has a guide, build script and web folder.

entries.name: DriftSeq
entries.author: johnskiller
entries.description: Early 16-track polymetric MIDI sequencer with per-track loop lengths, Euclidean and per-step probability generators, and a built-in GM monitor. So far a spec, host-tested C engine and browser emulator, not yet flashable.

entries.name: Crepuscular Homunculus
entries.author: TERKINSTEIN
entries.description: Dark standalone synth and four-track groovebox by TERKINSTEIN, formerly TERKINSTEIN firmware: curated sounds, six-operator FM, synthesized drum kits and 64-step tracks. Derived from Dinghy. Virtual FM-1.

entries.name: PIGEON
entries.author: The Shrimp Blimp
entries.description: Performance sampler by The Shrimp Blimp, based on Felucca: two songs with 32 chops each, 16 drum pads, a 64-step grid/piano roll, patterns/arrangement, effects and screen-reader support. The signed 0.5 final beta adds USB sampling, take audition/trim, selected-chop retention, 500 KiB usable storage and reusable browser chop collections; the browser tools include a sample editor and emulator with WAV/MP3 recording.

entries.name: Barge
entries.author: tradiuz
entries.description: Customizable firmware platform derived from Dinghy, with USB rescue, USB-MIDI, USB audio and statically linked instrument modules (reduced ANALOG, PHASE, LOFI, NOISE and WAVE engines, CLIPPER insert). Early, Barge-specific changes still in progress.

entries.name: Fart Machine One
entries.author: adamcharleswilsonmusic-code
entries.description: Novelty firmware with eleven sampled farts, reverb, delay and a sixteen-step sequencer. Installs with a Python script from a release download.

entries.name: REDACTED
entries.author: DJ Redacted
entries.description: Experimental four-track lo-fi groovebox by DJ Redacted, built on Felucca: ALGORITHM picks the track and four knobs set its fracture, static, chance and mutate. The installer offers 0.1 as a known-working rollback while 0.2 awaits hardware testing. Source comes as a project download, not on GitHub.

entries.name: ZEN-1
entries.author: aceyprime
entries.description: Ambient firmware of living Japanese scenes (cherry blossoms on a river, a koi pond, fireflies under a real moon) where every movement you see is a note you hear, with keys that play along. Built on FoMni and X0X, so on Felucca's platform.

entries.name: S1Vave
entries.author: AndrewGG88
entries.description: Eight-voice virtual analog tweak synth after the SH-101 and S-1: mono, unison, poly and chord modes, sub oscillator, OSC DRAW wave drawing and OSC CHOP, a 4-pole filter and stereo effects. Credits OberVave, Dinghy, Felucca and SLOOP. Source only, no release.

entries.name: FMEL-1
entries.author: AntonioAltea
entries.description: Mellotron-style firmware: tapes sampled from Bernie Kornowicz's 1973 M400S plus a SLOOP piano, mixable two at a time, with lo-fi tape effects. Browser simulator and web installer. Dinghy fork.

entries.name: FIELD
entries.author: AveyCole
entries.description: Radio of field recordings from Radio Aporee: browse by country or region on a globe, sample and layer recordings over WiFi or USB. Experimental alpha. Built on fm1-radio and fm1-base. Site and installer.

entries.name: HERA
entries.author: benbadio
entries.description: Chord groovebox that rebuilds the Roland J-6 workflow: 100 chord sets, 9 phrase styles with 12 variations each, a 64-pattern sequencer and a four-voice Juno-style synth. Browser demo and installer. Dinghy-based.

entries.name: MORPHEUS
entries.author: benbadio
entries.description: Eight-track ReBirth-style groovebox (808, 909, two 303s, breaks, FM lead, sub synth, MIDI) with a Reason Matrix-style pattern sequencer. Browser emulator and web installer. X0X DSP on Dinghy.

entries.name: Caravel
entries.author: bonszaimusic
entries.description: Multi-engine synth firmware continuing Felucca 1.6.1 independently, now at 0.5.0 with paired engines and a Lyra-inspired drone engine. Web installer, emulator and editor.

entries.name: Modular One
entries.author: Alexis Arakis (Bungle Society)
entries.description: Film-music firmware by Alexis Arakis (Bungle Society): a soft FM engine with 40 presets from the Modular Town plugin, delay, plate reverb, a MIDI player and a screen that follows the sound. Felucca fork. Beta, tested on one unit.

entries.name: LOOM-8
entries.author: Charles Vestal
entries.description: OP-XY-inspired groovebox by Charles Vestal: eight colour-coded tracks, 85 factory presets, a 64-step sequencer with step tricks and parameter locks, weave, throws and a conductor track. Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp.

entries.name: UNIBOX
entries.author: chinotto1
entries.description: Groovebox starting from FOMAJAM: nine tracks of modelled and ROM-recorded drum machines, an SH-101-style synth, a TB-303, a Juno-106-style synth, a wavetable synth, a USB sampler, 16 patterns and free recording. Source only, no release.

entries.name: FM1 Keyboard Academy
entries.author: chmess
entries.description: Beginner learning firmware: eight chapters of guided exercises, 30 public-domain melodies, lit keys and scoring, with the full FM synth behind the home screen. Based on M-VAVE's FM1 Open V14. Pre-release.
entries.license: GPL-3.0 with FM1 SDK linking exception

entries.name: Loom FM-1
entries.author: Co-oscillator
entries.description: Five-track synth, sampler and groovebox: four polyphonic tracks and a drum track over 14 engines (subtractive, wavetable, 6-op FM, tape scrub, granular, slicer), a 64-step sequencer and a chord progression generator. Built on Felucca.

entries.name: FM1 Betis Mode
entries.author: cotrino
entries.description: Real Betis football-themed firmware with a browser emulator and firmware workbench. Built on the official FM1 Open V13 SDK. Build-verified only, never flashed on a real FM-1.
entries.license: GPL-3.0 with FM1 SDK linking exception

entries.name: FM1 Cofrade
entries.author: cotrino
entries.description: Spanish-language Semana Santa firmware that replaces the 16 factory projects with 16 processional marches for cornets, trumpets and drums. Browser simulator and installer. Built on the FM1 Open V14 SDK, installed on one FM-1.
entries.license: GPL-3.0 with FM1 SDK linking exception

entries.name: MD-One
entries.author: d0pe1
entries.description: Mutable-derived drone machine: four Braids oscillators, tuned combs and a modulation system, playing into a DAW over USB audio. Runs on hardware at 42% CPU. Built on Dinghy. Source only, no release.

entries.name: Haunted FM-1
entries.author: davidpryan
entries.description: Five generative haunted-ambient firmwares (Midnight Route, Voicemail, Untrue Step, Half-Light, Worn Tape) in the manner of Burial, each with its own manual. Built on fm1-base.

entries.name: WitchBox
entries.author: davidpryan
entries.description: Six-track 2-step and melodic dubstep groovebox: ghost-chop sampler, sub, super-saw pads, 4-op FM keys, 8-lane synthesized drums and pattern generators. Dinghy-based. Builds and renders audio on the host, not yet run on an FM-1. Source only.

entries.name: Ravel
entries.author: De-Pattern
entries.description: Eight-track groovebox for sound design where synth, struck and drum tracks trigger, excite and modulate one another, with thirteen synth engines, a graph sequencer and an influence grid. Emulator and installer. Felucca family.

entries.name: Selva1
entries.author: DeAbrew
entries.description: Three-oscillator wavetable synth by DeAbrew inspired by the city of Sao Paulo, with 14 city-named wavetables. One C engine runs in the browser, as VST3/AU plugin and as FM-1 firmware derived from SLOOP and Felucca. Portuguese README.

entries.name: PERF-1
entries.author: deamonSLINKY
entries.description: Live-performance firmware by deamonSLINKY: ten genres of self-playing music with auto-DJ, a deep drum sequencer, a self-answering acid line, DX7-style voices, scenes and a web editor and emulator. Fork of HYP-1, so AMB-1.

entries.name: Flyfish
entries.author: delirioux
entries.description: One-piece firmware: Chopin's Etude in C major, Op. 10 No. 1, played on a sampled Steinway D that you can shape, practise and move. Built on Tuna and Felucca.

entries.name: Makohai
entries.author: delirioux
entries.description: Generative groovebox in the style of early-90s PC tracker music: six lanes composed live in seventeen styles that you queue and blend, with tracker effects. Site. Built on Dinghy.

entries.name: Tuna
entries.author: delirioux
entries.description: Generative music firmware that composes as it plays: Marbles-style randomness shaped by music theory, in the manner of a chosen composer or character preset. Built on Felucca.

entries.name: BOP-1
entries.author: devrvega
entries.description: Music toy for children that is also a real synthesizer: music plays on switch-on and each knob changes a visible friend, growing from pressing things (age 3) to a subtractive synth with real names (9-12). Built on Felucca.

entries.name: ROM-1
entries.author: devrvega
entries.description: Sixteen-part sound module in the manner of 90s rack modules: one part per MIDI channel with filter, envelopes, reverb and chorus. Plays `.sf2` files converted in the browser. Built on SEQ-4, CRT-4, LCD-4 and IND-1.

entries.name: fm1-amy
entries.author: dpwe
entries.description: AMY's Juno-60 patches as a six-voice polysynth, editable from the AMYboard editor and usable as a MIDI instrument. Experimental, played on one FM-1. Built on X0X and Felucca. Source only, no release.

entries.name: Golana DZ Edition
entries.author: dzwerg
entries.description: Golana fork adding 64-step sequencing, song mode and USB MIDI out. Experimental beta.

entries.name: Mini-Tone
entries.author: Stephane Schmitz
entries.description: Six-track Felucca 1.5 fork by Stephane Schmitz with new engines (SID, Braids, TB-303, Elektron and Digitone-style), a ping-pong delay, an ELEK reverb and track lengths of 1 to 64.

entries.name: Mini-Vision
entries.author: eldontyrellcorp
entries.description: Wavetable synth after Roland's n/vision, forked from Mini-Tone 1.0.4 (so Felucca 1.5).

entries.name: FN ACID
entries.author: Electro-Dig
entries.description: Firmware where every track is a function y(s, phi) played as drawn, after AA's "turning math into acid": 16-step acid line, ping-pong delay and curve-bending punch-in effects. 0.3 test builds, site. Built on Dinghy, SLOOP and Felucca.

entries.name: BREAK//174
entries.author: EremanSim
entries.description: Jungle instrument (Russian README) that plays a 166 BPM groove on PLAY with eight procedural drum voices, seven break families and a browser version. 0.2.0 alpha, not yet tested on an FM-1.

entries.name: PALEOTONE
entries.author: fantasmoslam
entries.description: Dinosaur-themed synth with creature voices (SAURUS) and SCAPE music. Early alpha. Browser emulator, installer and manual. GHOULBOX fork.

entries.name: DRIFT (Fabian Freitag)
entries.author: FBNFRTG
entries.description: Ambient synth with a repeating generative Euclidean sequencer: two oscillators, eight voices, a monochrome interface. Web player and installer. Based on Felucca.

entries.name: Fantasma
entries.author: Gadlele
entries.description: Ghostly ambient Felucca fork by Gadlele: a pad that writes its own chords, self-playing bells, ten ambient noise textures, an Omnichord on the keys and reverb tails to about 90 s. Installer and browser demo.

entries.name: Golana
entries.author: Gadlele
entries.description: Analog-style synth after the microKORG by Gadlele: two oscillators, five filters, two LFOs, a patch bay, an arpeggiator and a step sequencer, with a screen that draws each page. Felucca fork. Installer and browser demo.

entries.name: MNM-1 (galfaroth)
entries.author: galfaroth
entries.description: Six-track monophonic synth and FX firmware with a resonant filter and tape delay per track, three LFOs per track, parameter locks and slide. Forked from Hortator, with sounds ported from MONO2K. Site and emulator. Source only, no release.

entries.name: Speak37
entries.author: genkigenki
entries.description: Talking Speak & Spell-style synth by genkigenki: every key speaks the next word of a sentence at its pitch, with MOPE, a robot who judges your chords. Runs on the SMK-37 and the FM-1 (`speak37-fm1` build). Felucca platform.

entries.name: Erik37
entries.author: genkigenki
entries.description: Sampled concert grand by genkigenki with velocity layers, dampers, pedals, string resonance and four rooms. Made for the SMK-37 and also built for the FM-1, untested on one. Based on fm1-base and felucca-bsp.

entries.name: Matryoshka
entries.author: glvno
entries.description: Transparent modular synth framework with nested, reusable assemblies and a browser patch editor. Fork of Modular-1, itself a Felucca fork.

entries.name: GR!MM
entries.author: GRiMMBIENT
entries.description: Dark ambient, dungeon synth and deathdream firmware: four tracks, seven sound sources, long dark effects, a 64-step sequencer and one-key chords. Browser demo and editor. Felucca-based.

entries.name: KAWA
entries.author: Guizmoh
entries.description: Pocket tracker aimed at chiptune and IDM: six tracks, 4-bit waves, pulse, noise, FM, sliced breaks, 32 live effects, and English, French and Spanish screens. Beta 0.6, untested on a real FM-1. Built on Dinghy.

entries.name: No Man Sky FM
entries.author: hericdk
entries.description: Space-adventure firmware: one hand flies the ship with two knobs, the other plays music. Land, mine, fight robots, warp. v0.5 on SLOOP 2.7.1. Site, installer and 3D simulator.

entries.name: MODELAR
entries.author: hirakos999
entries.description: Semi-modular drone synth played like a Kaoss Pad: four cross-modulating oscillators, with the white keys as an XY pad grid and 11 gesture shapes on the black keys. Beta 0.3. Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp.

entries.name: BRUTAL FM
entries.author: hiroikezawa
entries.description: Experimental FM firmware with a four-operator FM/PM core and 4x4 modulation matrix, four modes (METAL, GROWL, CHAOS, NOISE), a wavefolder, A/B sound morph and a complex arpeggiator that loops the keys you hold. Felucca-based. Japanese README.

entries.name: DRIFT (MaxPower)
entries.author: I-am-MaxPower
entries.description: Ambient firmware with a drone that follows your chords, four Euclidean rhythm lanes and an Omnichord-style strum plate on the white keys. FoMni fork. No release yet, build from source.

entries.name: Bongo Cat's Tiny Studio
entries.author: Impossible Knot
entries.description: Playable band firmware by Impossible Knot: four cats, thirteen sound engines, a generated backing band and a looper for your own melodies. Built on Felucca 1.6.1. Release candidate.

entries.name: Demake synth
entries.author: InigoHernandez
entries.description: Ambient lofi machine built on 64 recordings made with pedals, played by three synths with piano rolls, patterns, scenes, a song mode and a chord machine. Browser version and installer.

entries.name: MONO2K
entries.author: InigoHernandez
entries.description: Monomachine-style firmware: six mono machines, a 64-step sequencer with parameter locks, trig conditions and ratchets, a lofi bus and a 1-bit screen. Browser version and installer. Built on Felucca, X0X, FoMni and other open FM-1 work.

entries.name: Clipper
entries.author: isod89
entries.description: Experimental synthesizer firmware that grew out of SLOOP, with per-voice ENV2/ENV3 and LFO2/LFO3 modulation. Based on Felucca. Web installer and editor. Version 1.1, experimental.

entries.name: J6
entries.author: JackieAlacrity2373
entries.description: JUNO-60-style six-voice polysynth: one DCO per voice, 24 dB resonant low-pass, high-pass, stereo chorus, poly/unison/solo modes, arpeggiator and a 16-step recorder. Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp.

entries.name: FM-1 Studio Tess
entries.author: Inputsignwave
entries.description: Development snapshot by Inputsignwave combining Melodee's synths with Tess generative sequencing, with source, tests, install notes and a developer handoff. No release; hardware acceptance incomplete.

entries.name: FM1-GM
entries.author: jartificer
entries.description: General MIDI sound module and 16-track sequencer: 128 sampled GM programs, a GM drum kit on channel 10 and 64 song slots, with MIDI export. Site. Built on Felucca's platform through X0X and FoMni.

entries.name: Berlinan
entries.author: jiripisa
entries.description: Generative Berlin School sequencer as a standalone USB MIDI sequencer: voices on loops of unequal length, each on its own MIDI channel, with the FM-1 as clock master or follower. Installer. Built on fm1-base.

entries.name: fm1-dock
entries.author: joakimeriksson
entries.description: Joakim Eriksson's one-install firmware: synths are modules in flash slots that you pick from the HOME screen and deploy over USB MIDI, with a browser console for log and crash records. Page. Based on Dinghy.

entries.name: FM-1 SID
entries.author: Joakim Eriksson
entries.description: C64 SID synth by Joakim Eriksson with a cycle-exact 6510, reSID and an on-device GoatTracker 2 editor. Runs as an fm1-dock module. Built on Felucca's HAL.

entries.name: Scintilla
entries.author: joakimeriksson
entries.description: Elka Synthex on the FM-1: an integer C port of synthex-web's Synthex with all 80 factory patches, plus velocity and aftertouch from the FM-1's keys. Built on Dinghy.

entries.name: FM Lab
entries.author: jsmith13
entries.description: Six-operator FM synth built for learning FM: the DX7 engine (Dexed's maths in fixed point) with every parameter under a knob, plus a small arpeggiator and one-phrase looper. No drums or songs. Built on Dinghy.

entries.name: DelRio
entries.author: Jess Del Rio
entries.description: Ceremony rhythm box by Jess Del Rio: djembe, cajon, udu, clapsticks, maracas and triangle, plus berimbau and tanpura and shruti-box drones. Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp.

entries.name: Finton
entries.author: justynroberts
entries.description: Six-track trance machine after Rollwerk: kick, 909, bass, roll, lead and pad over a 66-progression library in five moods, with p-locks and a LIFT knob for builds and drops. Has a Web MIDI flasher. No release, build from source.

entries.name: genAMB
entries.author: Kayman18
entries.description: Generative ambient firmware based on AMB-1: two pad synths, a port of Mutable Instruments Rings, a six-voice FM synth with 16 presets and three sequencers ported from VCV Rack. Version 1.0 RC2; firmware and source archive are in the repository, no release. GPL-3.0 per its LICENSING.md.

entries.name: Saadet
entries.author: keremimo
entries.description: Single-part synth fork of Melodee with Bluetooth MIDI, native 24-bit audio and 384 shared user sound slots. Installer and web editor. Experimental.

entries.name: Acultur8 X0X
entries.author: keyboy250
entries.description: Experimental X0X fork with a browser firmware lab that loads WAV slice banks with exact markers, plus an illustrated FAQ. Site. Pre-release 0.1.32.

entries.name: AMB-1 Evolved
entries.author: kidbee85-beep
entries.description: Generative ambient firmware based on AMB-1, with 64 sound presets, 32 themes and 20 scales. Installer. German README.

entries.name: Bunker Evolved
entries.author: Kid Bunka
entries.description: Generative ambient firmware by Kid Bunka: four editable layers, 64 sounds, 24 worlds, GROW and scale-based variation, with an English installer, guide, browser simulator and editor. Based on Felucca. 1.0 RC2.

entries.name: Cut-A-Dor
entries.author: Kid Bunka
entries.description: Beat firmware by Kid Bunka with eight recordable punches, soundbanks, a browser editor and a recovery kit. The release includes the source and a copy of the original V15 firmware.

entries.name: Mutable Dreams
entries.author: Kid Bunka
entries.description: Generative firmware by Kid Bunka: six assignable tracks, 12 engines, 224 tones, 76 Biomes, user banks and a browser instrument and live editor, with thanks to Mutable Instruments. Version 1.1.

entries.name: Gnomad
entries.author: kpalaniuk
entries.description: Kid-friendly firmware: sound pictures instead of menus, four colour knobs and a singing Gnome, with a full synth underneath. Installs with a Python script. Based on Felucca 1.0.1. Site.

entries.name: Frodhes
entries.author: leonardoMirabal
entries.description: Physically modelled electric piano, vibraphone and marimba with no samples, plus effects, arpeggiator, sequencer, scales and a web emulator. Built on Dinghy. Releases also carry experimental SMK-37 builds.

entries.name: Bytemania
entries.author: llozd
entries.description: Bytebeat synth with 30 patches (8 basic waveforms and 22 classic bytebeats credited to their authors), your own formulas written on the device with a live compiler, and note-controlled playback speed. Built on Dinghy.

entries.name: OPLBOX
entries.author: LXXero
entries.description: Turns the FM-1 into an AdLib: OPL2 emulation plays SoundFX Macs Opera songs, and a `.CMF` tracker and editor saves to nine flash slots. The release includes `fm1_install.py`.

entries.name: AMARU OS
entries.author: Marco Casanova
entries.description: Four-track generative firmware by Marco Casanova for hard genres (tekno, acid, hardcore, jungle, drum and bass, psytrance), with wavetable, FM, granular and analog synthesis per track. Derived from Bunker Evolved 1.0. Alpha, no release. Browser page.

entries.name: TastyWaves
entries.author: marksweiss
entries.description: 12-voice wavetable synth: two oscillators per voice, resonant filter, two envelopes, LFO, four-slot effects chain, arpeggiator and two step sequencers, plus a browser tool for patches and your own wavetables. Site. Built on Dinghy.

entries.name: Monohull
entries.author: markterm
entries.description: Monosynth with analogue-modelled oscillators, five filter models (transistor ladder, diode ladder, OTA cascade, Sallen-Key, state-variable), unison, chorus, delay and reverb. Built on Felucca's hardware layer. Tested on a real FM-1.

entries.name: LAUNCHPARTY
entries.author: megagott
entries.description: Experimental firmware pairing playable synth sounds with interactive Novation Launchpad Pro MK3 lightshows: clips, 27 keyboard overlays and an Auto Party mode. Sibling of MYCELIUM, derived from SLOOP and Felucca.

entries.name: AmbWave
entries.author: mentalcells
entries.description: Ambient instrument: latch a chord, add an evolving drone, resonant bowls or scattered notes, and shape the scene with four knobs. Browser demo and installer. Built on Felucca.

entries.name: NU//METAL SKRATCHMASTER PRO
entries.author: mhellar
entries.description: Robot turntablist with a nu metal band, by Mark Hellar: the SAM speech synth says 27 words you scratch on the keys and jog wheel, over a drop-tuned band with a tempo-synced LFO and a rap mode. Web installer. Built on Dinghy and Felucca.

entries.name: Synthesthetic
entries.author: michaeljsmalley
entries.description: Sends video over USB so the FM-1 shows up as a camera in OBS, Zoom and FaceTime, with 30 visualizers that react to the music, on top of a four-track groovebox. Based on SLOOP 2.7.1. Beta. Site.

entries.name: Felucca MPE
entries.author: monch1962
entries.description: Felucca 1.6.1 fork that adds MIDI Polyphonic Expression: per-note pitch bend, pressure and timbre from an MPE controller such as a LinnStrument, set under MENU > MIDI > MIDI IN. No release, build from source.

entries.name: X0X-RMX
entries.author: Mr-Roboto
entries.description: X0X fork with an Orb-inspired ORB Remix mode, Grids, Morph and USB project backup and restore from Chrome or Edge. Validated on a physical FM-1 by its maintainer. Site.

entries.name: FMER
entries.author: Nacsez
entries.description: Six-operator FM and virtual analog synth with four-track sequencing, plus FMER Companion, a Windows app for instruments, projects, backups and a guided firmware installer. Pre-1.0.

entries.name: FM-PLAITS
entries.author: @narti_live
entries.description: Generative Plaits voice by @narti_live, built on M-VAVE's FM1 Open V14, with a manual and the source as a zip; GitHub Actions builds the firmware. No release.
entries.license: GPL-3.0 with the FM1 SDK linking exception

entries.name: Prysm
entries.author: Nicholas Pratt
entries.description: 4-voice wavetable FM synth by Nicholas Pratt: two oscillators per voice, each a chain of three wavetable operators, a self-oscillating filter, a lo-fi drum machine, two LFOs, chorus and delay. Built on Dinghy. Releases also carry CLAP plugin builds.

entries.name: ACID FM
entries.author: NorfolkHacker
entries.description: IDM and braindance firmware, a JIANT FM fork, with acid-coloured virtual analog and FM sound pages. Installer and browser emulator. Version 0.4.

entries.name: GATOR
entries.author: npi3pak
entries.description: Monophonic macro-oscillator synth: the unchanged open-source Plaits DSP, with 24 models in 3 banks, a low-pass gate, ADSR, two LFOs and an 8-slot modulation matrix. Web installer.

entries.name: Bigorna
entries.author: nzimas
entries.description: Firmware for rhythmic noise, power noise, industrial and IDM, after the Elektron Digitone II: six tracks, four machines (4-OP, DRUM, WAVY, HIVE), a 16-step sequencer with parameter locks, a looper and send effects. Site and installer.

entries.name: Norilsk
entries.author: nzimas
entries.description: Firmware for ambient hellscapes and grim atmospheres: drones that never resolve, corroding textures and noise, everything drawn and wired at random. Site with installer and session backup.

entries.name: ESTAMPIE
entries.author: ocean
entries.description: Mediaeval groovebox: lutes, citoles, hurdy-gurdies, shawms, bagpipes over drones, frame drums and mediaeval modes. A GHOULBOX fork, with parts ported from Melodee. Site.

entries.name: fm1-wheel
entries.author: ograndebe
entries.description: Tonewheel organ after setBfree, for the FM-1 and the SMK-37 Pro: tone generator, scanner, preamp, reverb and Leslie, with drawbars, percussion and V1-V3/C1-C3 presets. Phase 1 runs on the host only so far. Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp. Site.

entries.name: Switch Blade
entries.author: OllieNicklinUK
entries.description: Four-synth expansion with no drums: OB-Z brassy poly, WAVE wavetable, NANO (a 303 plus a polyphonic subtractive synth) and JUNO with a Juno-60-style chorus, one machine per track on eight shared voices. Felucca fork. Site.

entries.name: Album
entries.author: joshbartlettband-web
entries.description: A series of firmwares, one per record: each patch pairs a sound with a photograph that moves as it plays. Album 01 has eleven patches, chord mode through a reverse reverb, and uses both cores. Built on fm1-base. Site. No release.

entries.name: Carnac OS
entries.author: OrbVorgis
entries.description: Wavetable polyphonic synth by OrbVorgis: 15 wavetable banks, seven voice architectures, four filter types, spring, tomb and tank reverbs, tape and BBD delays, sequencer, arpeggiator and layers with splits. Built on X0X. Web installer. Beta.

entries.name: Chipbox
entries.author: pbarilla
entries.description: Chiptune groovebox with more than 35 sound chips (NES, Game Boy, Master System, PC Engine, Mega Drive and more). Built on Dinghy. Play online and install.

entries.name: core-fm1
entries.author: DimmKirr
entries.description: Modular firmware framework that aims to build one image from chosen engines, effects and sequencers across the Felucca, Melodee and SLOOP lineages. Early: it builds, has emulator boot tests and shows a boot screen only.

entries.name: VNL-1
entries.author: pianomansam
entries.description: Lo-fi hip hop firmware built on fm1-base, with a browser emulator build.

entries.name: Oktowave
entries.author: PierreArnaudGUYOT
entries.description: Felucca 1.6.1 plus the WAVELET engine, a wavelet-transform synth ported from the Wavelet Synthesizer VST with 108 presets. Site with installer and browser build. Version 0.1, not yet run on a real FM-1.

entries.name: Arctic Scream
entries.author: PolarPatch
entries.description: Dark ambient drone firmware by PolarPatch, inspired by GR!MM, with Howl, a feedback-loop voice inspired by the Synthux Audrey II, a self-evolving DRONE mode and a 64-step sequencer. Browser demo.

entries.name: OPN-1
entries.author: putchdev
entries.description: Runs the Yamaha YM2612 and SN76489 chips, ported from ymfm and MAME, with 128 patches in four banks. A companion web app imports VOPM `.opm` patches and VGM instruments and streams game songs to the FM-1. Built on Dinghy.

entries.name: SID-1
entries.author: putchdev
entries.description: Two MOS SID chips (6581 or 8580, ported from reSID 0.16) giving six voices, with C64-style patches and a web page that pulls instruments out of `.sid` tunes. Built on Dinghy.

entries.name: FIZZ
entries.author: Quixotic7
entries.description: Eight-track step sequencer for ChoralRoot's FM TONE voice, with p-locks, conditions, chance, ratchets and chords of up to six notes. Also runs on a Mac as an FM1VST core with the FM-1 as its panel. Browser preview. Beta.

entries.name: RemoteFM1
entries.author: Quixotic7
entries.description: Firmware that sends the keys, buttons and encoders to a computer as MIDI and draws the computer's screen output on the FM-1, so an emulator-built firmware can use the FM-1 as its panel. Early, no release yet.

entries.name: Tonic
entries.author: RahelPuest
entries.description: Digitone-style FM groovebox with FM, VA and drum engines, 12 voices and a 64-step sequencer with p-locks. Browser emulator and web installer.

entries.name: OpenIFW-fm1
entries.author: rcell233
entries.description: Monophonic synthesizer port of OpenIFW, built on Dinghy, with a browser demo and USB web installer. Chinese README. Release candidate 0.4.7-rc8.

entries.name: LUOGU
entries.author: Reytian
entries.description: Peking opera percussion and accompaniment by Reytian: 64 luogu jing patterns with play-along scoring and 18 banshi with jinghu interludes. Built on fm1-base. Chinese manual.

entries.name: More Chords
entries.author: rosen
entries.description: ChoralRoot remix by rosen with extra engines adapted from Melodee and ORBIT (Prophet, Swarm, Cluster, Cloud). Web installer and browser emulator. Source ships as zip archives. No licence stated.

entries.name: FMini-1
entries.author: Guilherme Ruppert
entries.description: Minimoog Model D emulation by Guilherme Ruppert with effects, arpeggiator and sequencer. Partly based on Felucca. Web installer.

entries.name: OrganVave-1
entries.author: Guilherme Ruppert
entries.description: Tonewheel organ by Guilherme Ruppert, ported from setBfree: nine drawbars and eight factory patches. v0.1.0, not yet tested on a real FM-1.

entries.name: DUB-1
entries.author: sbegueria
entries.description: Generative dub techno machine that plays itself from power-on: chord stabs into a tape echo, FM pings, sub bass, kick, shaker and hat on an eight-bar arrangement. AMB-1 fork. Browser emulator and installer.

entries.name: 386DX
entries.author: seajaysec
entries.description: Singing karaoke robot with a band, after Alexei Shulgin's 386 DX: sings imported karaoke and MIDI files and typed lines to the notes you play, with a step sequencer and 16 punch-in effects. Web page.

entries.name: B1 Drawbar Organ
entries.author: SikkenWorks
entries.description: Drawbar organ by SikkenWorks: tonewheel-style SINE engine and an experimental SAWTOOTH engine, nine drawbars, rotary speaker and percussion. Uses Felucca's platform code. Site. Beta.

entries.name: DIRGE
entries.author: sinscum
entries.description: Darksynth, noise and drone firmware with fifteen engines, 64-step sequencer per track, song chain and MIDI clock in. Built on Felucca 1.6.1. Browser emulator, installer and editor.

entries.name: MNM-1
entries.author: sirpearson
entries.description: Elektron Monomachine-style groovebox with six monophonic tracks, three LFOs, a 64-step sequencer with parameter locks and an arpeggiator. Felucca platform. Italian README. Experimental, not yet tried on hardware.

entries.name: MOPE-1
entries.author: slothpallas
entries.description: Sad wavetable synth with a toy-keyboard backing band and an animated blob on screen. FiMba-1 fork. Installer and browser demo. Beta, tested on one FM-1.

entries.name: NOIZ DEMONS
entries.author: spike-the-percussionist
entries.description: Felucca fork where rolling a random sound summons one of 30 Ars Goetia demons whose sigil fills the screen and whose rank sets how far it bends the sound.

entries.name: SPIRALFM1
entries.author: Spiralfractalplugins
entries.description: Psytrance groovebox on SLOOP and Mycelium 1.0: six grooves, four factory songs, a PSY FX page and per-track probability. Beta.

entries.name: FRASIL
entries.author: styvesgoupil
entries.description: Ambient drone firmware: latched drones with shimmer reverb and freeze, GLINT FM bells with arpeggiator and 32-step sequencer, and a bass line. Built on fm1-base, keeps Felucca's flash layout. Site.

entries.name: NIGHTFALL
entries.author: SylarPu-X
entries.description: Cyberpunk performance firmware with synth, sequencer, FX, a web simulator, device editor and browser updater. Uses Felucca's platform. Experimental, booted on one FM-1; the release includes the source archive.

entries.name: Haave
entries.author: thebrodi
entries.description: Dreamy ambient firmware: a chord progression plays on PLAY, white keys add layers, black keys change chord, no menus or drums. Felucca fork. Browser demo. Work in progress, no public release yet.

entries.name: MASIF
entries.author: thecemeterygates
entries.description: Four-track sample tracker and rack sampler with 16 songs and 128 instruments. Built on SLOOP and Felucca. Web page with sampler and guide.

entries.name: Cat Piano
entries.author: thefriendlyhedgehog
entries.description: Each of the 27 keys plays a real cat meow, with four banks, a pitch-bend knob, four-track sequencer and arpeggiator. Fart Machine One fork.

entries.name: AEther
entries.author: twaroshinto
entries.description: Spectral PaulStretch-style synth that turns each note into a dense cloud, on fm1-base. Polish and English manuals. v0.5, not yet tested on hardware.

entries.name: Quod
entries.author: tulpasoftworks
entries.description: Drone instrument where one root note summons a cluster of thirteen sine voices on a ladder of just intervals. Built on Dinghy. Also a macOS Audio Unit, a VST3/CLAP plug-in for Windows, and a browser version.

entries.name: BBL JAM BOX
entries.author: Blair (blairysbeatlab)
entries.description: Digitone/Model:Cycles-style groovebox by Blair (blairysbeatlab): six tracks, 4-operator FM, 808-style drums, browser-loaded sampler and p-locks. Cut-down Felucca. Beta.

entries.name: RIFT
entries.author: Mr.V / PUZAOSI
entries.description: Bass and sequencer firmware by Mr.V / PUZAOSI: ACID, RUMBLE, REESE, GROWL and SCREAM engines, DNA-generated sequences, MIDI in/out and 8-track USB audio. Built on Dinghy, Felucca and SLOOP. Chinese README.

entries.name: Modular-1
entries.author: WiggisModular
entries.description: Nord Modular-style patchable synth with a modular engine, arpeggiator and web patch editor that uploads to the FM-1. Reuses Felucca's loader and hardware layer.

entries.name: KIDBOY
entries.author: WillCMcC
entries.description: Toddler toy: 27 nursery songs, letters, numbers and piano cards, with the buttons as drums and no menus. Built on Felucca 1.6.1. Version 0.1.

entries.name: CRATE
entries.author: zisonzishen
entries.description: Slice and performance sampler for jazz-hiphop, meant to sit beside an FM-1 running SLOOP: upload samples over USB-MIDI, slice them into 16 pads and sequence them. Built on the Felucca HAL. Phases 0-5.

entries.name: Shine On
entries.author: zvenson
entries.description: Seventies string machine on four tracks with six formant registers, BBD ensemble and phaser, mixer, step sequencer and 32 programs. Reuses OberVave's panel and sequencer. SMK-37 builds are also released.

entries.name: K-WASUB
entries.author: Omnipotard
entries.description: Modern bass synth for DnB, dub, dubstep and techno: wobble, reese, sub and 808 engines, EQ, a morph between four sounds and effects on the keys, with a drum sequencer. Built from KAWA by Omnipotard. Browser emulator, installer and manual in the repo.

entries.name: Zen-Lite
entries.author: Hi-Fi-Hopes
entries.description: The Zenthesizer plugin cut down for the FM-1: six voices of two engines (analog oscillators and wavetables) into a ladder filter, with envelopes, LFOs, a 12-slot mod matrix, effects and 179 presets. Built on Dinghy. No releases yet.

entries.name: DREADNOUGHT
entries.author: TwistedGenetics
entries.description: Dark jungle and drum & bass firmware: Reese and dread basslines, distorted 808s, wavetables with Serum import, a Rex-style break chopper and a web editor. Built on X0X's platform.

entries.name: CRT-4
entries.author: devrvega
entries.description: Four-track groovebox that plays the sound chips of nine consoles and home computers, with the screen dressed as the chosen console. Browser emulator and web installer. Built on LCD-4, IND-1 and AMB-1.

entries.name: SEQ-4
entries.author: devrvega
entries.description: Four MIDI sequencers for the instruments around the FM-1, one per channel and USB port, in six modes (melody, chords, drums, generative). The FM-1 makes no sound of its own. Browser emulator and web installer. Built on CRT-4.

entries.name: MIDIMON
entries.author: ignis32
entries.description: MIDI monitor and router in a green-phosphor look: watches and filters TRS, USB, USB host and BLE MIDI, and routes between ports as a matrix. Can act as a BLE MIDI dongle. README warns of brick risk and suggests installing the open bootloader first. Built on fm1-base.

entries.name: TRIO
entries.author: Reytian
entries.description: Jazz trio by Reytian: you play the chords, and small neural networks on the FM-1's chip walk the bass and play the drums. Site. Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp.

entries.name: BEETLE BLUE
entries.author: Joppe Sikken (SikkenWorks)
entries.description: Drum-focused fork of BEETLE by Joppe Sikken (SikkenWorks): six drum lanes, two ROM kits, twelve user kits, song mode and punch-in effects. Web installer. V0.94, experimental.

entries.name: ACID FM1
entries.author: kclack
entries.description: Acid bassline instrument: monophonic saw/pulse voice, slide, accents, ratchets and probability on up to 64 steps, with two browser emulators. Version 0.1.0, not yet run on a real FM-1.

entries.name: FM-1 Neverhood
entries.author: egorgam
entries.description: Tribute to The Neverhood: 22 presets, a four-track sequencer and a battery indicator. Characters, sounds and sprites come from the game's demo files. Installer and emulator. Built on fm1-base.

entries.name: RED MASS VAMPIRE OS
entries.author: Karsei
entries.description: Firmware by Karsei with six tracks (five instruments plus drums), 256 built-in sounds, 32 user slots, 64-step tracks, song mode and automation. v0.5.1-alpha; the release has no attached firmware file, so build from source.

entries.name: ONE CLICK FM-1
entries.author: Orbitator
entries.description: Song generator: one press builds a key, chord progression and six matching tracks (bass, chords, lead, drums, kick and loop with your own samples). German README. v0.2, never run on a real FM-1. Felucca-style controls.

entries.name: CHORDS
entries.author: Mighty-stack444
entries.description: Chord generator: pick a scale and root, white keys play the scale's chords, black keys its notes. Twelve sounds, voicings, hold, arpeggiator, bass and effects. Built on FoMni's platform. Not yet run on a real FM-1.

entries.name: SkurkyMello
entries.author: joakimskurk
entries.description: Native FM-1 port of the SkurkyMello browser instrument, built on Dinghy; CI applies it as an overlay on a pinned Dinghy checkout. No releases.

entries.name: Shed
entries.author: Luisnvb
entries.description: Jazz ear-training mode built on FM1 Open: functional degrees, chord qualities, intervals, tensions, scales, dictation and a Vamp mode that loops a progression. Enter with HOME+SCL. Shed Web for the browser.

entries.name: SPELLBOX
entries.author: Philippe Jaccoud
entries.description: Talking spelling toy by Philippe Jaccoud, after the 1978 Speak & Spell: an 8-character fluorescent display, a 10-pole LPC voice at 8 kHz and the Spell, Letter, Say It, Secret Code and Mystery Word games, with the keys as an A-Z keyboard. SPEAK says what you type (12,000-word dictionary plus letter-to-sound rules), SING and LETTER SYNTH play words and letters on the keys, and circuit-bending knobs bend the chip. Speech made with espeak-ng, no TI data. 0.3 beta, emulator and installer. Built on foma.

entries.name: FM-1+VA
entries.description: The first third-party firmware, by Madeline (Baud Girl). Keeps the stock FM engine, adds a virtual analog engine with supersaw, a 64-step dot-matrix sequencer with ratchets and chance, four assignable knobs on every screen, and a cleaner menu. Free, with a manual and web installer. The author has said the source will be released.

entries.name: Groove OS
entries.author: Peter Gombos
entries.description: Commercial eight-track groovebox firmware by Peter Gombos ($29). FM and VA engines, up to 20 voices, per-track loop lengths, drum machine, performance mode, browser emulator and manual. Built on top of the V15 firmware.

entries.name: April OS
entries.author: beashoko
entries.description: Sampling-focused Felucca fork: 32 three-second sample slots, an eight-track sequencer, a sample and loop editor, and recording through a computer's or phone's microphone. Its repository holds the installer page, not the firmware source.

entries.name: UTA BOX
entries.author: Kashiwayo-593
entries.description: Japanese singing firmware in two themes (Teto and Rose): write lyrics in kana and each key sings the next syllable at its pitch. Repo holds the .fwsc files, not the source.

entries.name: FM-1 Doom
entries.author: zvenson
entries.description: Playable Doom by sloopDX's author: one FreeDM arena on the keys and knob, synthesised sound effects, web installer.

entries.name: Mocky
entries.author: Charles Vestal
entries.description: Firmware and web app by Charles Vestal for sending pictures to the FM-1's screen from the browser.

entries.name: fm1-mdx
entries.author: Keitark
entries.description: Experimental MDX/PDX karaoke player on a software YM2151 that lets you mute a part and play it on the keys. Tested on a computer only.

entries.name: fm1-nes
entries.author: Keitark
entries.description: NES emulator running on the FM-1, published as a worked example of custom firmware development with board-support code and USB serial diagnostics.

entries.name: fm1-doom
entries.author: Keitark
entries.description: Doom engine port for the FM-1, in progress.

entries.name: fm1-radio
entries.author: Charles Vestal
entries.description: Internet radio by Charles Vestal: joins a 2.4 GHz WiFi network, plays Radio Garden stations and adds punch-in effects on the keys. Proof of concept, source only with no binaries because the AC79 WiFi libraries cannot be redistributed under the GPL yet.

entries.name: fm1-doom (Deadlock)
entries.author: seanohollaren
entries.description: E1M1 of Doom with title screen, sound and music, on the rp2040-doom engine and Felucca's hardware layer. Web installer. Experimental.

entries.name: Doom FM-1 / SMK
entries.author: Chance Roth
entries.description: Doom-engine port with nine maps and three weapons for the FM-1 and SMK-37 Pro and Elite. By Chance Roth. Browser simulator and installer.

entries.name: GameDude
entries.author: Chance Roth
entries.description: Game Boy emulator for the FM-1 and SMK-37, with a browser player and simulator that prepare a firmware from your own ROM. By Chance Roth. Play and install.

entries.name: NESynth
entries.author: Chance Roth
entries.description: NES emulator (InfoNES core) for the FM-1 and SMK-37 with a browser player and firmware builder. Experimental, mostly NROM, MMC1, UxROM, CNROM, MMC3, MMC2 and Color Dreams mappers. By Chance Roth. Play and install.

entries.name: Trireme FM-1
entries.author: ignis32
entries.description: Turns the FM-1 into a programmable USB keyboard and macro pad configured with Vial or on the device: any key or media/mouse key on every key, button and knob, five layers. README warns it is AI-written and not fully hand-tested.

entries.name: fm1-ctrl
entries.author: johnskiller
entries.description: Work in progress thin controller firmware that makes the FM-1 the input device for any firmware's web emulator over USB MIDI, with a WebMIDI shim and JSON control maps. Host-tested modules and a panel emulator so far.

entries.name: RAMBEAVER
entries.author: Adam Wilson
entries.description: Side-scrolling action game by Adam Wilson: defend the dam, ride through robot city, fly to the data center and beat Mother. Platform derives from Felucca, X0X and FoMni. Source is a release zip.

entries.name: Hungry Travis
entries.author: Adam Wilson
entries.description: Spoon-feeding balance game by Adam Wilson: keep the bean in the bowl, tip the spoon, with a grumpy 3D face and character voices. Firmware and source zip sit in the repository, no release.

entries.name: FMDj
entries.author: DeadActive
entries.description: LSDj tracker and DMGo! drum machine running in a Game Boy emulator on the FM-1. You supply your own ROM and the install page adds it to the firmware in the browser. Site and simulator. Felucca-based.

entries.name: NOCT FM
entries.author: Joolo09
entries.description: MIDI controller firmware with pixel screens and one permanent preset for FL Studio and Ableton Live, with DAW scripts, an installer and an emulator. Engineering alpha, Russian README.

entries.name: Deal or No Deal
entries.author: Kiwi3p
entries.description: Genesis-style Deal or No Deal parody game: 26 cases on the keys, a pixel-art host, a chiptune soundtrack and a robot voice reading the banker's offers, all generated at build time. Built on Felucca. No release, build from source.

entries.name: TransitFM1
entries.author: Quixotic7
entries.description: Silent stopover firmware for moving between custom firmwares: answers installers as V15, brings ChoralRoot's flash safeguards and writes the next firmware itself. 0.1.2 was withdrawn.

entries.name: Threadboard
entries.author: NotAKerbal
entries.description: Turns the FM-1 into a physical console for T3 Code, Codex or Claude Code threads: each active thread gets a white key, and key lights flag questions, approvals and finished work. Firmware plus a local bridge and dashboard.

entries.name: FM1 time-signal source
entries.author: rfb
entries.description: Repurposes the FM-1 as a WWV-style time-signal station feeding an AM/SSB transmitter, keeping the fictional Haida Standard Time for amateur station VA7BFR. Browser flasher and simulator. Based on FM1 Open.

entries.name: SLOOP Floyd FM
entries.author: renebohne
entries.description: Steht im Mooring-Katalog (installierbar), aber (noch) nicht in der awesome-fm-1-Liste.

entries.name: SLOOP DX7 Banks
entries.author: majnikool
entries.description: Steht im Mooring-Katalog (installierbar), aber (noch) nicht in der awesome-fm-1-Liste.

entries.name: Dinghy
entries.author: zvenson
entries.description: Steht im Mooring-Katalog (installierbar), aber (noch) nicht in der awesome-fm-1-Liste.

resources.name: FM-1-RE
resources.description: The deepest public analysis of the stock firmware: architecture, memory map, OTA protocol captures, security audit of recovery entry points, Ghidra scripts and V13/V14 firmware images. WTFPL.

resources.name: fm1-custom-fw
resources.description: Teardown photos, hardware notes (chip, flash, no debug pads), analysis of the macOS M-UPGRADE app and a Python SysEx flasher and scanner.

resources.name: fm1-nes GETTING_STARTED
resources.description: Source-only integration with the JieLi AC79/WL82 SDK, build setup for the pi32v2 toolchain, and guides on application-only updates that preserve the bootloader. Start here if you want to write your own firmware.

resources.name: fm1-emulator
resources.description: Rust emulator that runs FM-1 firmware images (`.fwsc`, `.elf`, `.bin`) on your desktop with the screen, buttons and USB serial console, so you can test without flashing. GPL-3.0.

resources.name: FM-1 browser emulator
resources.description: Rust/WebAssembly emulation of the AC791N's two pi32v2 cores and the board's screen, keys, audio, USB and flash, running unmodified `.fwsc` firmware in the browser. Russian README. GPL-3.0.

resources.name: Dinghy
resources.description: The smallest firmware to build your own on: a four-voice sine on top of working, documented plumbing for updates, USB rescue, USB-MIDI, USB audio, panel, screen and settings. Based on Felucca's platform. GPL-3.0.

resources.name: fm1-bootloader
resources.description: Readable C bootloader for the FM-1, restructured from a byte-identical reconstruction of the AC79 SDK's stock bootloader. Apache-2.0.

resources.name: MvaveFM1-Designer
resources.description: Visual editor for designing FM-1 panel states (key and button LEDs, knob roles, a mock-up of the 240×240 screen) with a JSON format to share them. MIT.

resources.name: fm1-firmware-patcher
resources.description: Binary patches for the stock V15 firmware: Dexed-accurate detune, removes aftertouch vibrato, recolours the oscilloscope. Unlicense.

resources.name: MVAVE-M-UPGRADE-decompiled
resources.description: Decompilation of the official updater application.

resources.name: jielie
resources.description: Reference site for JieLi SoCs, the family the FM-1's AC791N belongs to.

resources.name: JieLi AC79 SDK documentation
resources.description: JieLi's official documentation for the AC79 family: dev board, toolchain setup, SDK build and module examples. Chinese.

resources.name: jl-uboot-tool
resources.description: JieLi flasher and dumper. Source of the `wl82loader.bin` used by FM-1 Transporter.

resources.name: ghidra-jieli
resources.description: Ghidra processor module for JieLi's pi32v2 CPU, needed to disassemble the firmware.

resources.name: jl-misctools
resources.description: Miscellaneous JieLi utilities.

resources.name: Schwung
resources.description: Charles Vestal's framework for the Ableton Move. Not an FM-1 project, but X0X and Lunar Modulator borrow its 909, 808, 303 and PSX Verb modules.

resources.name: fm1-emu
resources.description: Joakim Eriksson's emulator of the FM-1 itself that runs community firmwares unchanged in the browser, natively or as an AU/VST3 plugin, plus an SMK-37 emulator. Play it in the browser. MIT.

resources.name: Felucca emulator with MIDI knob control
resources.description: Unofficial build of Felucca's browser emulator where MIDI CC 20-27 can turn the panel knobs, with absolute and relative encoder modes. GPL-3.0.

resources.name: foma
resources.description: FM-1 Makers' Assistant: write firmware in one C file with only Docker installed, hear it in a WebAssembly browser emulator as you save, and install or rescue from the same page. A smaller take on Dinghy. Project page. GPL-3.0.

resources.name: felucca-bsp
resources.description: Base for custom firmware on M-VAVE synths built around JieLi chips: clock, interrupts, flash, USB, UART, timers and boot entry, with board code per device and no sound code or UI. Work in progress, licences under review. MPL-2.0.

resources.name: Felucca-Engines
resources.description: Five Felucca synthesis engines (ANALOG, LOFI, TRIO, WHEEL, NOISE) and their DSP helpers as plain fixed-point C99 with a build-time sample rate. MIT.

resources.name: FM-1 Macropad Patch
resources.description: Unofficial patch for stock V15 that makes every button, key and knob send a USB-MIDI note so an app on the computer can turn them into shortcuts. Contains no M-VAVE firmware. Patch page. Japanese README available. MIT.

resources.name: Fluyt
resources.description: Nine of Felucca's sound engines as units for the KORG drumlogue and microKORG2, with the panel generated from Felucca's parameter tables. Web demo. GPL-3.0.

resources.name: sloopy-sloop-32
resources.description: Proof-of-concept port of SLOOP to an ESP32-S3 with a PCM5102A DAC, using the browser as the front panel. Runs on hardware and in QEMU. GPL-3.0.

resources.name: fm1-playwright
resources.description: Playwright test harness for fm1-emu: rotates encoders, presses buttons, plays notes, captures screenshots and records GIFs of firmware UIs. MIT.

resources.name: setup-fm1-emulator
resources.description: GitHub Action that installs the fm1-emu WebAssembly emulator for firmware UI tests in CI, no hardware needed. MIT.

resources.name: fm1-base
resources.description: Charles Vestal's base and template for FM-1 firmware on felucca-bsp: platform layer, host simulator, browser emulator and install tools. CTL-1 and the Radio firmware are built on it. Beta. MPL-2.0.

resources.name: setup-fm1-toolchain
resources.description: GitHub Action that installs the JieLi AC79 SDK and Linux toolchain for FM-1 firmware builds, mirroring both as release assets. MIT.

resources.name: mvave-fm1
resources.description: Claude Code skills and a podman build container for backing up, flashing, recovering and writing FM-1 firmware. MIT.

resources.name: fm1-linux-update
resources.description: Update stock V14 to V15 from Linux with verification, since M-VAVE only ships Windows and macOS updaters. MIT.

resources.name: fm1_flasher.py
resources.description: Standalone CLI flasher and preset uploader from the fm1-custom-fw project.

resources.name: fm1_ota.py
resources.description: Linux USB-MIDI update client from the FM-1-RE project, with offline protocol tests.

resources.name: FM-1 Transporter
resources.description: Read and write the FM-1's flash from a Mac through a Seeed XIAO RP2040 wired to the USB data lines. Dumps the full flash in seconds and is the recovery path for a device that no longer starts. MIT.

resources.name: USB_KEY dongle notes
resources.description: Lunar Modulator's write-up of the RP2040 dongle that forces the AC791N into download mode over USB-C.

resources.name: MvaveFM1Unbricker
resources.description: Python script that restores a soft-bricked FM-1 (black screen, installers report "FM-1 not found") over a plain USB cable through jl-uboot-tool, with a verified full-flash backup first. MIT.

resources.name: flipper-fm1-recovery
resources.description: Uses a Flipper Zero to put the FM-1 into ROM recovery mode, then backs up and restores the flash from a Windows PC. No RP2040 or wiring needed. Unlicense.

resources.name: fm-static
resources.description: Web installer for FM-1s whose MIDI port shows up under another name, which makes the usual updaters report the device as missing. Source, GPL-3.0.

resources.name: How to update the firmware
resources.description: Plain walkthrough of the official M-UPGRADE process.

resources.name: fwradar changelog
resources.description: Version history with changelogs for V09 through V15.

resources.name: M-Flasher
resources.description: Backs up, restores and installs firmware on the FM-1 and SMK-37 Pro/Elite through the chip's USB download mode, so it works on a broken unit. Also installs the open bootloader. Windows, macOS and Linux, with a command line.

resources.name: fm1_rescue.py
resources.description: The FM-1 Firmware Hub's Linux rescue script: sends the FM-1 to the AC791N's mask-ROM bootloader, checks the flash chip, chip key and package, then rewrites only the firmware area, reading every sector back. For units no USB-MIDI installer reaches any more. GPL-3.0.

resources.name: Slipway
resources.description: Windows app that lists community FM-1 firmware, checks the file and installs it through Felucca's installer, always keeping stock V15 as the way back. Includes a rescue flow and a recovery guide for a black-screen FM-1. MIT.

resources.name: FM1Kit
resources.description: Swift package that installs `.fwsc` firmware over USB-MIDI from iOS and macOS and can finish a cut-off update. Not yet tested widely on real hardware. MIT.

resources.name: FM-1 Transporter multiboard
resources.description: Derived workspace of FM-1 Transporter and MvaveFM1Unbricker that adds board profiles for recovering a USB-silent FM-1 with other RP2040 boards, including a DollaTek guide. Italian tutorial; DollaTek path untested on real hardware.

resources.name: m-bootloader
resources.description: Clean-room open bootloader for the FM-1 and SMK-37 Pro/Elite that adds a download mode and a recovery menu on the keys, plus the flash loader M-Flasher uses. Release has .fwsc installers. MIT.

resources.name: FM-1 Swap
resources.description: Android app that installs community firmware over USB MIDI, with the official V15 bundled as the way back, backups, a phone-side preview and DX7 patch sending. Inspired by FM-SWITCH. APK in releases. MIT.

resources.name: FM-SWITCH
resources.description: iPhone, iPad and Mac app for swapping FM-1 firmware over USB, with a firmware list merged from the Firmware Hub and fm1-editor.com and the official V15 bundled. By the author of FM1Kit. No licence stated.

resources.name: FM1 Editor & Librarian
resources.description: Browser-based DX7 voice editor and patch librarian built for the FM-1 by Benny Sparra: ten local banks, full operator editing, the FM-1 effects chain, SysEx import/export, six languages. Works with stock and FM-1+VA firmware. Source, MIT.

resources.name: DXcompanion
resources.description: Free browser editor for the whole Yamaha DX family, with beta FM-1 support.

resources.name: Dexed
resources.description: The open source DX7 emulator and editor. The FM-1 accepts single-parameter SysEx from it, so you can edit live from the plugin.

resources.name: FM-1 Workbench
resources.description: Web app, Android app, VST3/CLAP controller plugin and an MCP server for the FM-1, with a DX7 voice library, randomize/mutate, drum sequencer and MIDI file player. Live. GPL-3.0.

resources.name: Virtual FM-1
resources.description: Software FM-1 as a standalone app and VST3/AU plugin for macOS, Windows and Linux, with two-way preset and pattern sync to hardware running FM-1+VA. GPL-3.0.

resources.name: FM1VST
resources.description: Plugin that runs Felucca-family firmware (ChoralRoot, Felucca, Melodee) compiled from source, switchable in place. Planned as VST3, AU and standalone. GPL-3.0.

resources.name: FM-1 Mobile
resources.description: Real FM-1 firmwares (X0X, Felucca, SLOOP, FiMba-1) compiled to WebAssembly behind a touch panel laid out like the instrument, for phones. Source, GPL-3.0.

resources.name: sloop-fm1-go
resources.description: Android editor for the SLOOP firmware, based on SLOOP's web editor. GPL-3.0.

resources.name: SLOOP 8-Track Web Workstation
resources.description: Hybrid workstation that drives SLOOP's four hardware tracks over Web MIDI and adds four browser tracks beside them. GPL-3.0.

resources.name: FM-1 Pulses
resources.description: Generative browser sequencer that broadcasts MIDI live and can freeze 64-step phrases into the FM-1's patterns on FM-1+VA firmware. Live.

resources.name: FM-1 Utility
resources.description: Dependency-light Web MIDI editor for the FM-1.

resources.name: fm1-read-voice
resources.description: Read the current voice back from the FM-1 over USB MIDI, which the stock firmware does not offer through other editors.

resources.name: fm1-bank-sender
