resources.description: Android APK to send `.syx` sound banks to the FM-1 from a phone.

resources.name: fm1_soundbank_app
resources.description: Command-line tool to list, reorder and send a 128-preset soundbank over USB MIDI.

resources.name: mac-usb-midi-bridge
resources.description: Play the FM-1 from a USB-only MIDI keyboard through a Mac. Also available for Android. MIT.

resources.name: Felucca-WebApp
resources.description: Source of Felucca's web installer and editor, which talk to the device over Web MIDI SysEx. Published at hugelton.github.io/Felucca. GPL-3.0.

resources.name: FM-1 Screen Reader
resources.description: Speaks the FM-1's screen (pages, knobs, messages, lists) or hands the text to VoiceOver, NVDA, JAWS or TalkBack. Web page works with X0X, FoMni, AMB-1, Polly, MONK-1, Mocky and CTL-1. MIT.

resources.name: FM1 Studio
resources.description: Android app that runs SLOOP, FM1 MOVE, Felucca, sloopDX, Ghoulbox and zp12 with native firmware displays, touch controls, a piano roll and sound editors. GPL-3.0.

resources.name: FM1 DECK
resources.description: Android app that runs the unmodified C code of Felucca, JIANT FM, SLOOP and Hortator behind a touch panel, with up to three firmwares in one rack and Ableton Link. Preview. GPL-3.0.

resources.name: felucca-vst
resources.description: Builds Felucca, and firmwares built on it such as GHOULBOX, into VST3, Audio Unit, LV2 and standalone plugins that run the firmware's own code. GPL-3.0.

resources.name: Falua
resources.description: Early VST3, AU and standalone plugin that runs the sound engines of the JIANT firmware, a Felucca fork, unmodified on the computer. Currently exposes the ANALOG engine. Portuguese README. GPL-3.0.

resources.name: SloopStudio
resources.description: Native iOS and iPadOS eight-track workstation: tracks 1-4 sync with the FM-1 running SLOOP over CoreMIDI, tracks 5-8 are on-device Apple DSP engines, with a mixer. GPL-3.0.

resources.name: FM-1 Pulses Felucca
resources.description: Felucca fork of FM-1 Pulses: a browser generator of 16 sequences in a 4x4 project and track matrix with piano roll, written to the device over the editor protocol. Live page.

resources.name: SLICE64-FM Editor
resources.description: Web editor for the SLICE64-FM tracker firmware: patterns, song order, mixer, instruments and samples over Web MIDI. Open it. No license stated.

resources.name: Felucca Editor
resources.description: Windows Python scripts that edit Felucca 1.5 sounds, tracks, project slots and song chain over SysEx, also packaged as a Claude Skill. Chinese README. MIT.

resources.name: SLOOP Editor Skill
resources.description: DeepSeek Harness skill that drives SLOOP 2.4.1 over SysEx for four-track arrangements, drum kits and project slots. Chinese README. MIT.

resources.name: Octo-Vave
resources.description: Local Python app (Chrome or Edge) that collects free FM-1 firmware, ranks, downloads, checks and plays it, marking those tested on a real FM-1. Homepage. MIT.

resources.name: FM1 MIDI Converter
resources.description: Offline single-page converter between standard MIDI and FM1 V4 project files: the first 64 steps into a template project, or stored sequences out as MIDI. English and Chinese. Use it. GPL-3.0.

resources.name: Ghoulbox VST3
resources.description: Unofficial JUCE VST3 that runs the GHOULBOX firmware's own code with the FM-1's screen and panel in the plugin window. Prebuilt for Windows x64 only. GPL-3.0.

resources.name: FM-1 for Android
resources.description: Offline Android app with an FM-1 panel and eight source-compiled instruments: SLOOP, Felucca, X0X, Melodee, FM1 Open V14 preview, Skiff, FoMni and Jangada. No arbitrary firmware loading. GPL-3.0.

resources.name: PocketFM
resources.description: Native iOS FM-1 panel with the same eight pinned instruments as FM-1 for Android. Prototype tested on an iPhone 12, not an App Store release. Source tarballs in releases. GPL-3.0.

resources.name: Harbor
resources.description: Android app that plays FM-1 firmwares unchanged on the fm1-emu emulator, with USB and Bluetooth MIDI. APK in releases. No licence stated.

resources.name: FM-1 Pocket
resources.description: Phone web app (add to home screen) running the official FM1 Open V14 firmware compiled to WebAssembly behind a custom faceplate, offline after first load. GPL-3.0-only with the FM1 SDK linking exception.

resources.name: fm1-factory-presets
resources.description: The original 128 factory voices recovered as four DX7 bank dumps, since the onboard reset only restores imported data. Includes SysEx protocol notes, a provenance table tracing 126 voices to known DX7 libraries, and an FM synthesis tutorial PDF. CC BY-SA 4.0.

resources.name: fm1-banks
resources.description: 26 thematic 32-voice DX7 banks (832 patches) with provenance tracking and an audio gallery.

resources.name: This DX7 Cartridge Does Not Exist
resources.description: Neural-network-generated DX7 cartridges, fresh every reload. Loads straight into the FM-1. Source.

resources.name: Ambient & Dreams
resources.description: Commercial soundbank by NatLife Sounds made for the FM-1.

resources.name: fm1-sustain-footswitch
resources.description: Arduino board that turns a 3.5 mm sustain pedal into MIDI CC64 on the FM-1's TRS MIDI in, with schematics.

resources.name: FM-1 Bonus Box
resources.description: ESP32-S3 companion box: sustain pedal, rotary preset browser with a round TFT, WiFi soundbank manager, USB MIDI keyboard host and a sing-on-key trainer.

resources.name: fm1-midi-voice-tuner
